full_prompt_en: This is a square, cinematic photographic close-up of a dark-haired young adult woman turning toward the camera against a dim urban night background. Her head fills the upper center, while one bare shoulder and a dark red sleeveless top cross the lower right. Short, tousled black hair falls over her forehead and gathers loosely near the nape, with stray strands softening the outline beside her cheek. She looks over her shoulder toward the viewer, her expression quiet and alert. A thin necklace catches a little light along the back of her neck. The left side of the frame is almost black, leaving the face and shoulder isolated within a shallow zone of focus. Behind her, a cool turquoise circle glows near the lower left, smaller blue-green spots dissolve toward the right, and a soft red light hovers high in the distance. These colored points are blurred rather than readable signs. A warm, low side light reaches her cheekbone, nose, lips, and exposed shoulder; the opposite side of her face falls into deep green-brown shadow. The lighting preserves a slight sheen on skin without turning it glossy. The background's bokeh and dark atmosphere suggest a street or interior after dark without supplying identifiable architecture. Fine photographic texture remains visible in the midtones, while the darkest regions stay smooth and dense. The red top carries the strongest solid color, countering the turquoise and orange-red lights behind it. No text is legible. The overall composition is intimate and tense, using a close face, colored points of light, and a large dark margin to concentrate attention.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一张方形、具有电影感的摄影近景，一位深发年轻成年女子在昏暗的城市夜景前转向镜头。她的头部占据上方中央，一侧裸露肩膀和深红色无袖上衣横过右下。短而略乱的黑发落在额前，在后颈附近松散收拢，零散发丝柔化了面颊旁的轮廓。她越过肩头望向观者，神情安静而警觉。一条细项链在后颈处接到少许亮光。画面左侧几乎全黑，让脸和肩膀孤立在浅浅的清晰区域内。她身后，左下附近有一团冷青绿色圆光，更小的蓝绿色光点向右方散开，远处高处悬着一抹柔和红光。这些彩色光点模糊，并非可读的标识。偏低的暖色侧光照亮她的颧骨、鼻子、嘴唇和裸肩，脸部另一侧则落入深绿褐色阴影。光线在皮肤上保留轻微亮泽，却不使其过分光滑。背景的虚化光斑和暗色氛围暗示夜间街道或室内空间，但没有可辨识建筑。中间调有细微摄影质感，最暗区域则保持平顺厚重。红色上衣形成最强的实体色彩，与后方青绿及橘红光相平衡。没有可读文字。整体构图亲密且紧张，以贴近的脸、彩色光点和大片暗边集中注意力。
style_prompt_en: The cinematic photographic finish sets warm amber-red accents against deep green-teal darkness. Shallow focus keeps one compact central area legible while distant lights expand into soft, rounded blurs. A low side light models surfaces with a thin transition from luminous planes to dense shadow; the darkest passages form broad quiet shapes instead of revealing every detail. Edges alternate between crisp focal contours and softened peripheral boundaries, giving the image a felt sense of depth. Fine midtone grain keeps the image tactile, while isolated colored glows supply rhythm across the otherwise dark field. The composition favors close cropping, an off-balance dark margin, and a few small lights over a fully explained setting. The overall effect is moody, immediate, and cinematic.
style_prompt_zh: 这种电影式摄影完成面让暖琥珀红色强调与深青绿暗域相对。浅景深使一块紧凑的中央区域清晰，远处光源则扩散为柔软圆形虚影。偏低侧光以很窄的过渡塑造表面，从发亮平面进入浓密阴影；最暗部分成为宽阔安静的形状，而非显露所有细节。边缘在清楚的焦点轮廓与柔化的外围边界之间交替，让画面产生可感的纵深。中间调的细颗粒使图像保持触感，孤立的彩色光晕为大部分暗色画域提供节奏。构图偏向紧凑裁切、不均衡的暗边和少量小光点，而非解释完整场景。整体效果幽暗、直接，充满电影气息。
theme_en: A dark-haired young woman turning toward the camera in colored night light
theme_zh: 深发年轻女子在彩色夜光中回望镜头
name: Luc Besson
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
